dataList.name: Delightful Swordbutchery
dataList.desc:
- Max Stack: 100
- On Hit using Skill Coins while "Battō Shisei" is equipped on Skill Slot, gain 10 Stacks (once per Skill)
- Consumed by certain Skills
dataList.flavor: 'The mind settles on the hilt grasped within my palms, then the blade leaps outta its sheath. Blink, and somebody's already hittin' the floor. Swords go clang, and crossroads of life and death flash before our eyes... There ain't no better game than that.'
